decision: PM_L1 scoped implementation under Owner rub_analytical_data_gaps_v1 delegation
anchor: last independently admitted previous observed source date, not an inferred completed session
target_rule: exact prior ordinal dates from accepted FO TradeStats witness; missing target is not substituted

capture.baseline_load: existing accepted EOD or exact canonical raw only; no network or full backfill

observed_statistics_extension.store: accepted_si_observed_statistics in the existing canonical snapshot; linked to unchanged dated evidence digest
observed_statistics_extension.warmup_semantics: NEW descriptive reporting policy; not the old full-N warmup and not statistical confidence
observed_statistics_extension.selection: exact observed slots; unavailable dates excluded with reasons; never substitute older dates
observed_statistics_extension.raw_precedence: existing exact latest raw first; invalid raw excludes date without EOD or older-revision fallback; accepted EOD only if raw absent
observed_statistics_extension.source_byte_binding: facts decoded from the same verified frozen raw or accepted EOD partition bytes
observed_statistics_extension.derived: FIZ/YUR long, short, net, gross and exact1/5/20 changes; separate participant-side count changes
observed_statistics_extension.percentile: weak empirical CDF count(sample <= anchor) / actual sample_count
observed_statistics_extension.consumer_self_description: each current/dated view repeats formulas, weak-CDF tie inclusion, anchor inclusion, ddof0, minimum2 and constant-sample refusal
observed_statistics_extension.consumer_usability: mixed statistics block has no top-level current_usable; each view has explicit anchor_role and current_pair_usable_at_read, true only after existing current admission
observed_statistics_extension.consumer_anchor_clocks: each admitted view exposes unchanged snapshot_ts, availability_ts_utc, source_publication_time and ingest_ts_utc; refused current exposes no anchor clocks
observed_statistics_extension.consumer_semantics_preserve_evidence: output-only metadata; stored schema, evidence digest, linked dated identity, first acceptance and arithmetic remain unchanged
observed_statistics_extension.current_and_dated: same bounded history and formulas; current additionally requires existing live admission and exact current observed-date witness
observed_statistics_extension.legacy_current_statistics: consumer current statistics replaced by new view or explicit refusal; original snapshot legacy engine data remains audit only
observed_statistics_extension.compact: summary metrics, exact sample dates/exclusions and locatable input_snapshot audit reference; no full 504 factual rows
observed_statistics_extension.retention: unchanged economic sample retains own first acceptance; linked dated evidence identity/first acceptance unchanged
observed_statistics_extension.verification: independent Decimal arithmetic, exact source slot/subset inventory, complete metadata and refusal checks including Python -O
